newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota Motor to reduce sedan models -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Toyota Motor to reduce sedan models -- paper.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp plans to reduce its model range of small to medium-sized sedans amid a market trend towards sport-utility vehicles, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun business daily reported on Tuesday.
The company plans to halt sales of two of its sedan models as early as 1998 and will consider taking similar measures on other sedan models, the paper said.
A Toyota spokesman declined to comment on the report, but said the company plans to introduce about 10 new models, mostly sport-utility vehicles, in 1997.
The company plans to increase the ratio of its sport-utility vehicles from the current level of nearly 40 percent of its total sales. It would not give a target figure or time frame.
